## What changed (player-visible first)

## Slice

`slices/NNN-.../SLICE.md` (or "chore")

## How it was verified

- [ ] Acceptance check from SLICE.md: paste the output
- [ ] Compiles; EditMode tests pass (PlayMode tests if runtime behaviour changed)
- [ ] Screenshot / clip attached for player-visible changes
- [ ] `ASSET_SOURCES.csv` updated for any new external or AI asset
- [ ] No Unity YAML text edits; every new asset has its `.meta`

Anything not run is marked NOT_TESTED.

## Risk area?

None / networking / save / IAP / release / security / licensing. If this touches one of these, a second review is required before merge.
